tools.name: find_hotel_by_name
tools.description:
FlightPowers single-property lookup: live Booking.com availability and pricing for one named property. Input: the hotel name a person would type (adding the city helps when a chain has many properties) plus check-in and check-out dates -- no internal property ID needed.

Returns the property's price
